metadata.title: Interactive Tajweed Graph
metadata.description: Explore Makharijul Huruf and Sifatul Huruf through an interactive graph visualization. See how hijaiyyah letters connect to their articulation points and traits.

legend.title: Legend
legend.trait_lazimah_description: Permanent Trait is a trait that is always present in a letter.
legend.trait_aridhah_description: Conditional Trait is a trait that is only present in a letter under certain conditions.

welcome.title: Welcome to Playground! 👋
welcome.description: This is an interactive visualization of Tajweed rules. Let me show you around.

canvas.title: Interactive Graph
canvas.description: Click any node to highlight its connections. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom.

controls.title: Zoom Controls
controls.description: Use these buttons to zoom in/out and fit the graph to screen.

graph_filter.title: Settings Panel
graph_filter.description: This is the settings panel. If it's closed, click the header to open it before continuing.

view_mode.title: View Mode
view_mode.description: Filter what to display: All, Articulation (Makhraj), Trait, or specific Letter.

letter_selector.title: Letter Selector
letter_selector.description: Select a specific letter to focus on.

layout_mode.title: Layout Mode
layout_mode.description: Choose between Radial (circular) or Hierarchical (tree) layout.

hierarchy_direction.title: Hierarchy Direction
hierarchy_direction.description: Choose between Vertical or Horizontal direction.

edge_style.title: Edge Style
edge_style.description: Toggle dynamic edges that follow node positions, or choose static edge shapes.

edge_shape.title: Edge Shape
edge_shape.description: Choose between Bezier, Straight, Step, or Smoothstep edge shapes.

graph_legend.title: Legend
graph_legend.description: This shows the color coding for different node types. If it's closed, click the header to open it before continuing.

trait_info.title: Trait Details
trait_info.description: Click the question mark icon next to a trait to see its detailed explanation.

node_letter.title: Letter Node
node_letter.description: Orange nodes represent Hijaiyyah letters. Click to see connected articulation points and traits.

node_articulation_point.title: Articulation Point Node
node_articulation_point.description: Outlined blue nodes represent articulation points (specific makhraj).

node_articulation_area.title: Articulation Area Node
node_articulation_area.description: Solid blue nodes represent articulation areas (general makhraj).

node_trait.title: Trait Node
node_trait.description: Outlined purple nodes represent letter traits (specific sifat).

node_trait_group.title: Trait Group Node
node_trait_group.description: Solid purple nodes represent trait groups (general sifat).
